common_name: JN2 Pink Heartbreaker Redbud (Weeping Burgundy-Leaf Dwarf Redbud)

planting.note: Plant container-grown trees in fall or early spring in moist, well-drained soil in full sun to partial shade; since JN2 is typically top-grafted onto a standard trunk, stake the leader while young so it gains height before the cascading side branches are allowed to sprawl.

directions: This compact weeping redbud produces heart-shaped foliage that opens deep burgundy-pink before settling to a softer green-and-plum blend through summer, giving the cascading canopy an unusually colorful, drooping profile. Rosy-lavender flowers stud the bare, pendulous branches in early spring, standing out against the tightly weeping form. Because the habit stays low and mounding rather than climbing, most nursery stock is grafted onto an upright trunk, so keep the central leader staked for the first few seasons until the desired head height is reached. Give it well-drained soil, since like other redbuds it resents standing water at the roots, and site it where afternoon shade will keep the leaf color from bleaching in hot summer regions.
sources: Just Add Nature Nursery / J.C. Raulston Arboretum
